description: This file defines a React component 'ShelfModal' for adding a new shelf in a book management app. It handles user input, validates shelf name length, and communicates with an API endpoint to save the new shelf. It includes UI elements like TextFields, Buttons, and Alerts, and uses Material-UI components for styling and responsiveness.

classes.name: ShelfModal
classes.description: React component for adding a new shelf, managing its own state for input and message display, and handling form submission with API integration.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Updates the component state with the current value of the shelf name input field.

methods.name: submitShelf
methods.description: Validates the shelf name, calls the API to save it, and updates UI messages based on success or failure.
